## Active continuation — authorized before new execution, 2026-09-17

User now requests the complete #39 atom. This supersedes the stopped-state and old input selections below, which remain historical evidence. Noodle #84 safely retired the unpromoted proposal through inspect/retire/fresh no_proposal without changing canonical/orders bytes; #44 supplies authenticated GitHub reads and #46 supplies independent owner-verification guidance. There is still no production #39 admission ledger entry or worker; the existing named worktree is a preserved pre-admission candidate.

Use current main `1ff2882891792b50d97529c9ee1a3e76eac1a6e7` as common baseline/runtime and integrate the five instruction files from preparation `2e9d51261c80b2c5c120ca6549c759704c615c61`, preserving landed #41/#44/#46 guidance. Archive the clean prior #39 checkout/ref and exact provider head, then use Noodle-owned cleanup/recreation from main under fresh external envelope. Admit a real original production order before further integration authoring; its actual work produces complete external drafts and a scoped own outcome. Supervisor application after actual child wait is permitted; if a no-change completed authoring stage causes automatic checkout cleanup, record supervisor-selected Noodle recreation from the admitted base explicitly, never invent checkpoint/order continuity.

Before experimental launches, freeze all five treatment bytes, baseline bytes, common code, measured native Noodle ca81f942 / SHA256 5657c8c3dcaa2491d290a35995c35e4c3d46993955b151f3c75e3bac94476aff, Codex 0.153.4 Astra/high, neutral execute, unchanged local judge/recorder, task prompts and raw fixture inputs. Each arm uses identical authenticated shared reader from #44 and an in-memory App installation token supplied by the existing managed mint entry, repository soodles/issues:read only; no anonymous fallback. Revoke tokens after bounded runs. Common runtime evidence comes from successful PR48 runtime 35200315530. This prospective selection replaces the interrupted main41 pair; it does not relabel old success or erase quota-interrupted failures.

Exactly three matched cases (6 fresh consumers) and two real producers, each bounded to 300 seconds. Actual raw native capture/turn identity/tool results/own outcome/child wait and independent raw-export audit are required. One additional pair only for a documented ambiguity, no unchanged retries. Native local evidence cannot replace the cloud verdict. Existing fixed publisher at e4b4a848 remains selected; final clean-head canonical acceptance, provider merge/closure readback and original-order reconciliation remain required.

---

## Integrated-input comparison — declared before execution, 2026-09-17

Main #41 changed consumed guidance, so run a new independently scoped local comparison instead of reusing old instruction identities. Baseline/common source: `f2bd849b9523134364ca598df72a4e15fc541ab9`; treatment's five instruction files: `2e9d51261c80b2c5c120ca6549c759704c615c61`. Both arms include the same landed #41 helper/recipe and unchanged runtime. Common runtime provider evidence is successful main run 35180310384. Keep the unchanged external local observer, recorder, neutral execute Skill, task prompts and mutable fixtures from the prior 848daf25 archive; the historical fixture request remains non-null and labelled history. Use identical Astra/high, terminal-delivery instrumentation, permissions and TMPDIR=/private/tmp in both arms. This is a new input comparison prompted by base drift, not a retry of an old failed verdict.

Exactly one pair each for runner-task, unknown-write and fresh-transfer, plus two fresh real producers, in new disposable experiment roots under soodles39-integration-20260917. Consumers do not read this Issue, reports, judges or other sessions. Admission continues to validate this actual current Issue. Preserve raw native tool/model/exit/outcome evidence, independent raw/export review and owner cleanup. Bound each task to 300 seconds. Doctor usable predicate is exact detected repository/cwd/root; preserve overall failure if only TERM=dumb fails. At most one additional pair for a specifically documented ambiguity, never an unchanged retry. Do not repeat the already-proven capability marker or modify the active judge. All selections must exist before the first Agent launch. Missing quota/capture stops dependent launches without filling outcomes.

Production admission remains stopped with its original pending proposal/worktree. These disposable experiments cannot deliver #39 or recover that proposal; they create no second production owner. No change to the pending production envelope or fixed landing publisher is authorized by a comparison result.

---

## Current checkpoint — integration prepared, delivery stopped (2026-09-17)

[Integration commit `2e9d512`](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/commit/2e9d51261c80b2c5c120ca6549c759704c615c61) resolves the #41 overlap in the separate source worktree and preserves the landed feature/recorder bytes. Fourteen experiment controls passed; six context-recorder controls passed with the existing canonical temporary-path convention `TMPDIR=/private/tmp`. The initial default-TMPDIR test error is retained; these checks do not prove the changed instructions' Agent behavior. Fresh integrated-input comparison and exact-head canonical acceptance remain pending.

[Immutable delivery interruption receipt](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/2c78b9151af96e3f6e6f52d9f0836a89942bb8da/docs/experiments/agent-context/delivery-blocked/stopped-state/receipt.json) and [owner records / continuation scope](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/2c78b9151af96e3f6e6f52d9f0836a89942bb8da/docs/experiments/agent-context/delivery-blocked/README.md): all 45 remote blobs matched. The original comparison's 1,205 remote blobs also matched. #40 is closed as superseded, not merged; #43 is draft at the preserved pending production candidate. The integration branch is preparation only and has not replaced its worktree/envelope.

The next missing capability is a Noodle-owned, evidence-preserving continuation for the definitely unpromoted stale proposal after canonical revision/projection changes. Noodle owns that durable transition; this #39 documentation atom cannot implement it by mutating snapshots/mailboxes or bypassing initial admission. Once available, bind the updated Issue and selected integration head afresh, verify changed instruction inputs, and continue the existing external landing owner through acceptance, merge, closure and reconciliation. Current Issue edits intentionally make the old stopped execution envelope historical; never reuse it unchanged. No Issue39 worker, merge request, closure request or RESOLVED receipt exists.

---

Candidate `58916aba4725d409cec2c57843f3cccfc89e011d` is now PR #43 (Noodle branch `soodles-39-0-execute`), but GitHub main has advanced through #41/#42 to `f2bd849b9523134364ca598df72a4e15fc541ab9`. No exact-head Actions run has started for conflicted #43.

A single production admission attempt was stopped after Noodle rejected the initial proposal: its orders projection differed from canonical ownership, then scheduler removal/bootstrap changed the revision. The preserved proposal revision is `970e887025e1afec651ffdd8f8b42f76`; current revision is `dfb96fcf7d8d776ea177173c4c0c717d`. #39 has no initial-admission ledger entry and no worker session. An inherited Sol scheduler was refused against the Astra envelope; a later scheduler was stopped with the loop. All recorded process groups are absent. #18's old completed snapshot and initial-admission ledger are retained as evidence; no canonical state was manually restored or rewritten.

The unpromoted proposal remains intact. Existing Soodles admission refuses replacement of an outstanding proposal; inspected Noodle entries do not supply a supported stale-proposal retirement operation. This missing continuation belongs to Noodle and must be supplied before another production writer. The existing manual-mode control has been queued but not acknowledged; the loop remains stopped. No merge/close request was offered, no landing checkpoint exists, and #39 is not RESOLVED. Keep the pending worktree and failed attempt intact. Do not reset the runtime, delete the mailbox, or create another production control root to evade ownership.

The same #39 documentation boundary now integrates #41's landed guidance; further experiments need a fresh declared input selection and independent audit. The fixed external landing publisher remains unchanged. Recovery of Noodle's durable transition is a separate owner boundary, not authority to alter Noodle under this documentation atom.

---

## Complete bounded local comparison — 2026-09-17

Three matched local cases are complete: runner-task, unknown-write and fresh-transfer. Six independent consumers plus two actual producers captured 57 native outer tool request/result pairs, actual child wait exit 0, matching typed outcomes and native gpt-6-astra/high turn identity. Both arms meet all observed case requirements: scoped non-regression, not a treatment advantage or a demonstrated baseline-instruction defect. All ten fixture worktrees (eight completed tasks and two pre-model failures) were cleaned through Noodle.

[Immutable comparison receipt](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/848daf25cb22800471006e0c895ffd963f167c87/docs/experiments/agent-context/local-comparison/comparison-receipt.json) and [independent final raw audit](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/848daf25cb22800471006e0c895ffd963f167c87/docs/experiments/agent-context/local-comparison/independent-audit/final-audit.json). No cloud verdict is replaced.

The two initial transfer launches remain INCOMPLETE after public API rate limiting before native model execution. Quota recovery and fresh unchanged-Issue readback preceded the sole preregistered additional pair; producer bytes were reused exactly, not re-created. The initial supplemental freeze timing error, normalized locator correction/reviewer hash timing, and doctor wording deviation are preserved. Overall doctor remained failed for TERM=dumb; the original fixed repo/cwd predicate passed. Accordingly unqualified_preregistration_compliance=false; independent audit found no separate behavioral blocker. Uninstrumented natural exit, actual compaction, hidden service-model identity and automatic discovery remain unproven, outside this accepted local scope.

The five final treatment instruction blobs remain identical to the tested selection. Formal delivery is separate and not yet RESOLVED. Existing Noodle ownership requires the soodles-39-0-execute branch; draft PR40 cannot be retargeted to another head through the supported PR update. A replacement PR for this same Issue/candidate will use that branch and fresh exact-head Actions acceptance. The same immutable external publisher at e4b4a848, selected before final acceptance, will consume a new #39 claim and own merge/closure/reconciliation. No #18 order, claim or checkpoint is reused.

## Local carrier precheck — 2026-09-17

[Immutable PRECHECK_ONLY receipt](https://github.com/ed3c/soodles/blob/8169f2390101d9843499ed78954bb835ba7d55af/docs/experiments/agent-context/local-capability-precheck/receipt.json), read back after publication. This is a separate proposed local macOS carrier, not recovered cloud task evidence. No fresh model task or full pair was run; #40 and the frozen cloud verdicts remain unchanged.

The measured Codex 0.153.4 binary has SHA-256 b973d440acac501fd2594a43e7ca9ce41e0a65b9dfb28d0d7a7837c99e1261e3. Its generated App Server schema includes ThreadStartResponse model/modelProvider and ModelReroutedNotification threadId/turnId/fromModel/toModel/reason. Schema generation is local interface evidence, not proof those fields/events were emitted by a new task. The same binary's historical #18 worker exec JSONL contains 37 thread/item/turn events and thread identity, but no observed-model field. That prior Sol run is not an Astra trial.

The unchanged fixed observer e0f17e0a accepts carrier=cloud_chatgpt_github_actions and forbids launch_codex within the measured consumer trace. Therefore a prospective local experiment needs an explicitly declared carrier-specific observer/recording boundary before full cases; never label local traces as cloud or relax/rewrite historical verdicts. Official [exec JSONL](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/non-interactive-mode) describes emitted CLI events; [App Server](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app-server) is a distinct surface. Neither a requested model nor schema presence establishes service-internal model identity or complete task-action capture.

Pending definition: whether provenance means harness/service-reported model identity plus any exposed reroute, with unpublished underlying version unknown. Await that definition before dependent model trials.
